text: PLUS is a division at Hanwha Life Insurance, South Korea's oldest life insurance company; LIV Golf describes it as Korean Golf Club's multi-year founding partner.
short: PLUS is a division at listed insurer Hanwha Life.

source.name: LIV Golf: LIV Golf Korea sees increase in strategic commercial partnerships and market engagements
source.quote: The franchise has secured a multi-year, founding partnership with PLUS, a division at Hanwha Life, which stands as South Korea's oldest and leading life insurance company.
source.note: The page shows no exact date ('4 months ago'); it covers the week of the 28-31 May 2026 LIV Golf Korea tournament.
